title: Three Terms and One Short Stage
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：hall　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hall 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the keeper ① swept a hall that no teacher in the school would have described, and he said the sweeping was the whole of the term. The ② hall, meaning the room itself and not the corridor, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a hall, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ hall in that school had the same short stage beside it, and the ④ hall at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hall, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the keeper said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hall was the whole of the matter, meaning the gathering and not the room. The ⑥ hall, meaning the gathering and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; hall, he said, is either something you sweep or the only word that means both a room and a gathering. He said the gathering is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ hall had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short stage. The ⑧ hall of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in November, was one school and three terms of describing; hall, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hall I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ hall, my mother said in 1978, is the only one that improves by being described; every hall, she said, is a gathering that has agreed to look like a room. She said the gathering was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 礼堂；大厅（指学校里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 礼堂；大厅（指那间厅堂本身，与走廊相对）
C. 固定搭配：sweep a hall 打扫礼堂
D. n. 礼堂（指留给孩子们用的那一座）
E. n. 会堂（抽象总称，指一所学校的礼堂之事）
F. n. 礼堂（指计划里写到、被记录过的那一座）
G. n. 集会；府第（指一件事里人人都去却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 聚会（抽象总称，指人人都去却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: swept a hall that no teacher in the school would have described
The hall, meaning the room itself and not the corridor
the hall at the far end
the hall was the whole of the matter
the hall had become a line in a plan
The hall of the whole thing
A hall, my mother said in 1978

answers.why: sweep a hall 意为“打扫礼堂”，1969 年那位管理员打扫了学校里没有一位老师肯描述的一座礼堂。
hall 意为“礼堂、大厅”，指那间厅堂本身而不是走廊，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
hall 意为“礼堂、大厅”，指学校里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一个矮矮的舞台。
hall 意为“礼堂”，指最远端留给孩子们用的那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hall 意为“集会、府第”，指一件事里人人都去却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场集会就是那件事的全部。
hall 意为“聚会”，指人人都去却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座礼堂，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hall 意为“礼堂”，指计划里写到、被记录过的那一座，到 1969 年这一座成了计划里的一行。
hall 意为“会堂”，管理员十一月写道，整件事的礼堂之事是一所学校和三个学期的描述。
hall 意为“礼堂”，我记得的是计划里描述过的那一座，1976 年修好了，至今仍被说成学校里最安静的一座。
hall 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，礼堂是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的厅堂。
